oliver_fin: Heads-up: Vendor connector sync to customer GammaApps was retried during 2026-03-12 maintenance, causing ~450k duplicate embed units. They asked for a breakdown and a provisional credit.

hema_eng: I pulled the connector logs. Connector retried due to 502 from our edge for a 12min window while maintenance ran. The connector doesn't set idempotency keys. I see repeated request hashes.

jun_sre: We have an export: s3://billing-exports/2026-03/GammaApps/connector-2195001110.csv. Billing export shows duplicates for 447,860 units.

pia_billing: GammaApps is on volume discount rate $0.00035/unit. Proposed credit = 447,860 * 0.00035 = $156.75. They already paid. Need CFO approval and audit note.

oliver_fin: Can we confirm which are true duplicates (same payload & response) vs legitimate retries? Hema?

hema_eng: I diffed response_hash and payload_hash. 430k look identical; 17,860 look like different payloads (client retried with different params). We'll only credit identical duplicates.

billing-bot: export ready and checksums: s3://billing-exports/2026-03/GammaApps/connector-2195001110.csv.md5

jun_sre: Mitigation: ops will add connector-rate-limit guard and recommend vendors adopt idempotency headers. Also plan to add a short window dedupe in the edge (config flag).

pia_billing: Request: please provide a short audit memo with affected event_id sample and final credited amount. CFO sign-off needed.

ola_fin: FYI @tanya_cfo

tanya_cfo: Approve credit of $156.75. Finance: please add a memo, include sample event_ids, and do not restate revenue without finance approval.

pia_billing: Will create credit memo CM-2026-03-089 and update invoice INV-2026-03-210. Notifying account team now.

oliver_fin: Closing note: vendor scheduled a post-maintenance runbook update to prevent retries without idempotency. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/EDGE-2022
